messages:
marta: Quick check — we're onboarding zeta-7b-v2. HF path shows `hf://redwood/zeta-7b-v2` but our registry points to `s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-7b-v2/weights.tar.gz`. Registry validation reports checksum mismatch. Anyone touched mirroring recently?
artifact-bot: Mirror job finished for redwood/zeta-7b-v2 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-7b-v2 at 2026-02-10T08:22Z; checksum: 3f4a2c... (registered).
devon: I kicked off a re-sync last night but stopped it early due to a permission error on the target bucket. Could be partial object metadata. @kai can you confirm that the cross-account role still has `s3:PutObjectAcl`?
kai: I removed a tight ACL from the role during infra cleanup. Re-adding now. Also re: checksum, run `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key models/zeta-7b-v2/weights.tar.gz --query ETag` and compare to HF sha256 manifest.
marta: Thanks. Also the tokenizer is failing short-sentence splits in serving smoke tests — looks like `tokenizer.json` has `added_tokens` as plain strings not objects. @arjun any known HF->registry normalization for tokenizers?
arjun: Yep, HF sometimes stores added tokens as lists of strs. Our manifest validator expects objects with `id` + `content`. I'll add a normalization pass in the registry upload lambda. Will push a tiny fix.
devon: Patch sounds good. For immediate unblocking, you can run the local normalize script:
```
python tools/normalize_tokenizer.py --in s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-7b-v2/tokenizer.json --out s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-7b-v2/tokenizer.json --fix-added-tokens
```
arjun: I'll open a PR with the lambda change and tag you both. Can you capture the checksum we saw? I'm worried `weights.tar.gz` got truncated.
marta: Checksum from HF manifest: `sha256:9b7c5e...`, s3 ETag returned "3f4a2c..." — mismatch. Likely multipart upload changed ETag vs sha256. Need to compute sha256 locally:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-7b-v2/weights.tar.gz /tmp/weights.tar.gz && sha256sum /tmp/weights.tar.gz
```
kai: Multipart ETag vs sha256 is a classic. We started using multipart for >5GB. If we want stable sha256 we should upload a `.sha256` alongside the artifact or record HF sha256 in the manifest. I'll update the mirror job to also store `<file>.sha256`.
devon: :thumbsup: I'll re-run the mirror after the role fix (ETA ~20m) and include `.sha256` in S3. I'll also mark the registry artifact as `verifying` until we confirm.
marta: Great. Can someone drop the PR link and the re-run job id when done? I'll hold the serving rollout until matching checksums and tokenizer fixed.
artifact-bot: MirrorJob#87213 started by devon at 2026-02-10T08:45Z; expected size 7.4GB.
arjun: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/registry/pull/498 — includes tokenizer normalization + manifest `sha` field. Note: downstream serving expects `manifest.checksums.sha256`.
devon: Re-sync finished. S3 now has `weights.tar.gz` + `weights.tar.gz.sha256`. HF sha256 matches the `.sha256`. ETag still different due to multipart. Rollout safe to proceed.
marta: Thanks all — proceeding with canary. Will post results in #eng-ml if anything flakey.
